answer: Who trusts a troupe that vouches only for itself? Each mask must earn weight from attesters on five separate branches of one vine, no branch carrying more than a fifth, each attestation sealed by a basalt bond no mask can share. Ten masks hiding behind one velvet curtain collapse into a single branch, sharing just 20% weight while paying ten bonds. One honest player earns a full share; a crowd behind one curtain earns a fraction. The stage pays for distance, not for crowds.
